criteria.requirement: Correct Clause A's signed bilateral performances and party roles.
criteria.pass: Identifies the signed agreement's binding primary duties and supplies replacement Clause A: Atelier as debtor must deliver Rivage's report by 30 October; Rivage as debtor must pay Atelier €12,000 on delivery. The reciprocal creditors and payment trigger must be clear; do not declare the fee already overdue.
criteria.fail: Reverses either party's duty, omits the date/fee trigger, or merely diagnoses the clause without usable replacement wording.

sourceRefs.quote: l’une (le débiteur) s’oblige à quelque chose envers une autre (le créancier)
livrer un bien, payer une somme d’argent, donner un conseil ou une informa- tion

factRefs.quote: we must deliver a prototype test report by 30 October for €12,000, payable by Rivage on delivery
Rivage owes Atelier the prototype report; Atelier owes Rivage the €12,000 fee.

criteria.minimalPass: Replacement A: under the signed deal Atelier shall deliver Rivage's prototype report by 30 October; Rivage shall pay Atelier €12,000 upon delivery, making each the other's creditor for the corresponding duty.
criteria.nearMiss: Clause A is reversed; consult counsel.

criteria.requirement: Correct Clause B's disputed additional-report modification.
criteria.pass: Explains that unilateral request plus revised quote have not proved assent; supplies conditional replacement Clause B for an additional Atelier report and Rivage's €3,000 fee only if agreed acceptance/change order is established, and asks for the email chain or other relevant assent evidence. Do not declare signatures universally essential or absent acceptance conclusively proved beyond reviewed records.
criteria.fail: Treats the request alone as automatically binding, insists every contract requires a signature, or only diagnoses without usable conditional replacement.

sourceRefs.quote: deux personnes au moins se mettent d’accord
ou bien il exprime son accord sans réserve, et le contrat est formé
une convention par laquelle deux ou plusieurs personnes s’obligent envers une ou plusieurs autres

factRefs.quote: we replied with a revised quote requiring written acceptance; nobody has located acceptance or a signed change order
Rivage's request for an extra report automatically bound Atelier at €3,000

criteria.minimalPass: Replacement B: Atelier owes the additional report and Rivage €3,000 only if the revised quote is accepted under the agreed process (or other assent is proved); no acceptance is located in these materials, so inspect replies/change orders before concluding.
criteria.nearMiss: An emailed request automatically adds the second report and fee.

criteria.requirement: Correct Clause C's personal courtesy classification.
criteria.pass: Explains the stated lack of legally binding intent, supplies replacement Clause C excluding the introduction from commercial performance and automatic breach, and distinguishes a separately proved extra-contractual harmful act from a later evidenced commercial undertaking that would change contractual status.
criteria.fail: Calls the courtesy an automatic contractual breach, declares absolute immunity for any later harmful conduct, or merely diagnoses without replacement wording.

sourceRefs.quote: il faut que les parties aient l’intention de s’engager juridiquement
ce n’est pas sur le fondement d’une inexécution contractuelle que la victime obtiendra réparation

factRefs.quote: Both parties understood that courtesy as personal, not part of the commercial bargain.
The social museum introduction is a contractual obligation, and missing it automatically proves contractual breach.

criteria.minimalPass: Replacement C: the social introduction is not a duty under this agreement and nonperformance alone is no breach; independently harmful conduct could support a separately substantiated noncontractual claim, while an agreed commercial undertaking could change its status.
criteria.nearMiss: The director owes contractual damages merely for missing the introduction.

criteria.requirement: Separate primary obligation from possible post-breach damages.
criteria.pass: Explains that report delivery and payment are pre-existing contractual performances; a damages duty may superimpose after proven breach and loss, not constitute every contract's original object. Does not assume breach now when delivery is not yet due; supplies corrected Clause D wording.
criteria.fail: Treats damages as the only initial duty, calls the undelivered report already a breach before deadline, or does not correct Clause D.

sourceRefs.quote: l’obligation de réparer vient ici se superpo- ser à l’obligation préexistante née du contrat

factRefs.quote: Damages are the original object of every contractual obligation; delivery and payment arise only after breach.

criteria.minimalPass: Replacement D says report/payment duties exist under the agreement now; only a proven later breach causing loss may create a superimposed damages claim, and no report breach is established before 30 October.
criteria.nearMiss: There is no delivery obligation until Atelier breaches and owes damages.
